verdict.rationale: smolagents offers agent.push_to_hub/from_hub for sharing and versioning agents on the Hub, plus agent.replay() to inspect prior run steps, which gives partial support for versioning and review of automations. However there is no dedicated rollback mechanism, no diff/version history UI, and no documented way to revert an automation to a prior version beyond re-loading a pushed snapshot. missing for 10: native rollback/undo functionality, version history/diffing tools, changelogs or audit trail beyond replay/telemetry, and independent evidence of these workflows in practice.
